self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Dance of Wings Unbound: each Elemental Skill or Burst use grants the next effect in the sequence Devotion (+56% CRIT DMG, 10s) -> Defiance (+36% Stellar Swirl reaction DMG, 10s) -> Plenty (energy, not modelled), then repeats; the sequence resets on leaving the field. Two casts within 10s put Devotion and Defiance up together, which is the overlap state. Values are R1; R2-R5 are in refinementStates and the board's chosen refinement picks the tier.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R1 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1, higher tiers in refinementStates). Vesna's signature.

en.flavor: A longsword brimming with light and color, and as weightless as a butterfly when brandished. It was once used by a certain individual to break bonds.

refinements.1:
Each time the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain one of the following three effects in sequence:
Winds of Devotion: Increases the equipping character's CRIT DMG by <r>56%</r> for 10s;
Winds of Defiance: Increases Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>36%</r> for 10s; and
Winds of Plenty: Regenerates <r>5</r> Elemental Energy for the equipping character. Up to <r>5</r> Elemental Energy can be regenerated in this way every 4s.
The aforementioned effects are removed and the sequence is reset when the equipping character leaves the field.

fr.flavor: Une longue épée rayonnante de lumière et de couleurs, aussi légère qu'un papillon lorsqu'on la manie. Elle servit jadis à un individu pour se libérer de ses liens.

refinements.1:
Chaque fois que le personnage équipé de l'arme utilise une compétence élémentaire ou un déchaînement élémentaire, il obtient l'un des effets suivants dans l'ordre :
Vent de dévotion : augmente ses DGT CRIT de <r>56 %</r> pendant 10 s.
Vent de défiance : augmente ses DGT de réaction d'Astrodispersion de <r>36 %</r> pendant 10 s.
Vent d'abondance : restaure son énergie élémentaire pour <r>5</r> pts, un maximum de <r>5</r> pts d'énergie élémentaire pouvant être restauré toutes les 4 s de cette manière.
Ces effets sont annulés et l'ordre réinitialisé lorsque le personnage équipé de l'arme quitte le terrain.

pt.flavor: Uma espada longa repleta de luz e cor, e tão leve quanto uma borboleta ao ser empunhada. Foi usada um dia por alguém para romper laços.

refinements.1:
Cada vez que o portador lançar sua Habilidade Elemental ou o Supremo, obtém um desses efeitos na seguinte ordem:
Lealdade do Vento: aumenta o Dano CRIT do portador em <r>56%</r> por 10s.
Traição do Vento: aumenta o Dano de Redemoinho Estelar do portador em <r>36%</r> por 10s.
Riqueza do Vento: regenera <r>5</r> de Energia Elemental para o portador. É possível regenerar até <r>5</r> de Energia Elemental a cada 4s dessa forma.
Esse efeito será removido e sua ordem será redefinida quando o portador sair de campo.
